trailhead.label: The fountain at San Giuseppe, Giaglione, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
A sunny, open slope with little shade: avoid hot afternoons and carry water for your dog.
Stretches on hamlet lanes and a short one on the provincial road through the hamlets: keep your dog on a short lead there.
The path back up to San Giuseppe is steep and stony for a short way.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Stretches on hamlet lanes and a short on: Tratti sulle stradine delle borgate e un breve tratto sulla provinciale tra le frazioni: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The path back up to San Giuseppe is stee: Il sentiero di ritorno verso San Giuseppe è ripido e sassoso per un breve tratto.
